facts.fact: Maliweb reports that at the eight Commune IV civil-status centres visited, digital payments pass mainly through Orange Mali and Moov Malitel mobile payment services, and the main mairie also uses Sama Money.
facts.system: Orange Mali, Moov Malitel and Sama Money mobile money

facts.fact: Maliweb reports that under decree 2024-0429/PT-RM of 19 July 2024, civil-status fees in Commune IV of Bamako have been paid by mobile money since 5 August 2024, with all eight centres visited confirming it works and the mairie holding a Treasury-supplied payment terminal.
